# Mburu M

I write to think through questions across data, health, technology, institutions, markets, books, and ordinary life.

My formal home is statistics and data science. The wider thread is representation: how reality becomes data, models, categories, stories, maps, institutions, and decisions. This site is a personal archive of technical notes, learning notes, book thoughts, and small observations that help me understand how things work.

:::

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const controls = document.querySelectorAll(".topic-pills button[data-topic]");
  const rows = document.querySelectorAll("#listing-listing tbody tr");
  const emptyMessage = document.querySelector(".topic-empty");

  if (!controls.length || !rows.length) return;

  const decodeCategories = (value) => {
    if (!value) return [];

    try {
      return decodeURIComponent(atob(value))
        .split(",")
        .map((category) => category.trim())
        .filter(Boolean);
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  };

  const categoriesByRow = new Map(
    Array.from(rows, (row) => [row, decodeCategories(row.dataset.categories)])
  );

  const applyFilter = (topic) => {
    let visibleCount = 0;

    rows.forEach((row) => {
      const visible = topic === "all" || categoriesByRow.get(row).includes(topic);
      row.hidden = !visible;
      if (visible) visibleCount += 1;
    });

    controls.forEach((control) => {
      const active = control.dataset.topic === topic;
      control.classList.toggle("active", active);
      control.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(active));
    });

    if (emptyMessage) {
      emptyMessage.hidden = visibleCount !== 0;
    }
  };

  controls.forEach((control) => {
    control.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(control.classList.contains("active")));
    control.addEventListener("click", () => applyFilter(control.dataset.topic));
  });
});
</script>
```
